marie_ops: Quick check-in before the weekly run: I pulled the capacity forecast for next week and noticed two potential hot spots. can folks skim and flag anything surprising?

david_infra: thanks marie. what are the hot spots?

marie_ops: us-west1 cluster-c (A100 pool) has a projected 22% increase in GPU-hours day-over-day due to the demo cadence + a recurring batch job shift to daytime. numbers: 
- Mon-Fri expected 58,400 GPU-hours total (was 48,000 last week)
- Peak concurrency predicted ~1.8x normal between 10:30-13:00 PDT

sophia_sre: thats a notable bump. any reason batch moved?

marie_ops: arjun pushed a schedule change to batch-sweep (he's on thread). it got moved to avoid nightly maintenance window. arjun, is that intentional?

arjun_pm: yes, we temporarily moved sweep because of DB downtime during midnight patching. we can shift lower-priority shards back to pre-midnight if infra agrees.

kevin_costs: cost note: if us-west1 stays at those hours and we fall back to on-demand instead of reserved bursts, incremental spend ~+$18k/week. also cross-region egress to eu-west2 for model sync spikes the bill.

marie_ops: eu-west2 cluster-b looks stable: forecast ~40k GPU-hours, small uptick for nightly evals (+6%). ap-southeast1 is trending up weekends because of a partner demo in APAC: expected 18k next weekend (was 9k).

david_infra: two operational notes:
1) autoscaler for cluster-c triggered 9x yesterday between 11:00-12:15 — logs show pod evictions due to node preemption in the spot pool.
2) network: we've seen transient TCP resets on the inter-subnet path between c-a and c-b in us-west1, ~0.3% of connections last 48h. Might exacerbate model reloads and increase KV cache misses.

sophia_sre: suggestion: temporarily restrict low-priority spot batch to off-peak windows, prewarm a small H100 reserved pool for the demo window (10:00-14:00 PDT), and enable prefix caching to reduce reload overhead.

marie_ops: agree. if we prewarm 8 H100s in us-west1 dedicated for 6 hours/day x 5 days, rough calc: 8 GPUs * 6h * 5d = 240 GPU-hours — should shave peak latency and reduce autoscaler churn. thoughts?

kevin_costs: cheaper than spot churn maybe — estimated cost delta +$7k/week vs +$18k if we can't stabilize and burn on-demand. Also recommend enabling burst reservations only for the demo window instead of full-time.

david_infra: operational action items I can take:
- move low-priority cron to 02:00-05:00 PDT (need SLA exceptions)
- patch autoscaler config: increase min unready timeout to 90s to avoid thrash
- create a 8x H100 reserved slice and attach a nodeSelector for demo jobs
I'll open the PR in a bit.

marie_ops: awesome. sophia, can you confirm SLO risk for the prefix-caching change?

sophia_sre: prefix-caching change is low-risk. will need small rollout: enable in canary routing for 10% traffic for 24h, monitor p99 latency and KV hit-rate. if p99 improves >15% we'll roll to 100%.

deploy-bot: autoscaler-alert: cluster-c autoscaler fired 9 times in 1h at 2026-11-08T11:12:03Z — details: https://redwood.internal/alerts/AS12345

arjun_pm: thanks everyone. i'll revert the batch shift for the next 2 deployments and coordinate with kevin on cost guardrails.

marie_ops: plan summary:
• Move low-priority cron back to 02:00-05:00 PDT (david)
• Create 8x H100 reserved pool for demo windows (david)
• Autoscaler tuning to reduce thrash (david)
• Canary prefix-caching (sophia)
• Cost guardrails and burst reservations for demo windows (kevin + arjun)
Please ack if you own or need anything else. :thumbsup:

david_infra: ack — will open infra PRs and tag owners.

sophia_sre: ack, will prepare canary dashboard and alert thresholds.

kevin_costs: ack. i'll add a cost watch and cap the burst reservation to the demo window only.

arjun_pm: ack, reverting batch schedule now. thanks all.

marie_ops: closing loop: i'll run an updated forecast after PRs merge and post an updated burn chart tomorrow morning. if anyone sees other region anomalies, ping here. :rocket:
